public.user_tutorial_settings.reason: Each account's guide settings, one row per account (migration 137): whether guides open every time, and the tutorials turned off. UI guide settings; no personal data beyond the account link.

jale_api.reason: lambda/api/tutorial-progress.ts reads the caller's settings and saves them with one upsert; no DELETE, so a row leaves only with its users row.

public.user_tutorial_settings.user_tutor.using:

   FROM users
  WHERE (users.cognito_sub = current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true))))
